snippet.title: Harbourlight - First Look - Gameplay
snippet.description:
The first look at the gameplay for my solo developed game Harbourlight. 

I’ve been working on this in my free time for a few months now and happy to say I’m getting closer to a finished demo. 

A few areas need polish but I will diligently be working through them. 

If you would like to follow this game, please consider wishlisting it on steam. 
Every wishlist helps make my game get closer to being finished! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4919050/Harbourlight/

If you have any ideas for characters I’d love to hear them. What characters you like and which you don’t. 

Any tropes you generally hate in these types of games? 

#cozygames #indiegame #pixelart #farmingsim #cookinggame #cozygaming #cozy #farmingsimulator #storydrivengames
